_about: Batch B6a (Model code): concepts/model-definition, concepts/weight-loading, concepts/tp-layers, code/model-executor-models-llama, code/model-executor-layers-linear. Owner: the B6a writer.

model-prefix.short: The dotted name of a layer in the model tree, for example model.layers.0.self_attn.qkv_proj. Each constructor gets it and passes a longer one to its children.
model-prefix.long: The quantization config uses it to pick a method per layer ({{cite vllm/model_executor/layers/quantization/base_config.py:203-217}}), and the Attention layer uses it as its key in static_forward_context ({{cite vllm/model_executor/layers/attention/attention.py:443-445}}).

stacked-params.short: One vLLM parameter that holds several checkpoint tensors side by side, for example qkv_proj for q_proj, k_proj and v_proj. A shard id says which part a tensor fills.
stacked-params.long: Llama stacks q/k/v into qkv_proj and gate/up into gate_up_proj ({{cite vllm/model_executor/models/llama.py:348-357}}). Older model files use a stacked_params_mapping list in load_weights instead.

weights-mapper.short: A small rule set that renames checkpoint tensor names to vLLM parameter names (by prefix, suffix, substring, regex), drops some names, and adds shard ids for stacked parameters.
weights-mapper.long: Fields and order of the rules: {{cite vllm/model_executor/models/utils.py:48-145}}.

auto-weights-loader.short: A helper that walks the module tree with the (name, tensor) stream. It calls a child's own load_weights if it has one, else the weight_loader of each parameter.

weight-loader.short: A function stored on a parameter (param.weight_loader). It copies one checkpoint tensor into the parameter and keeps only the slice that this TP rank owns.
weight-loader.long: Parameters without one use default_weight_loader, a shape check and a copy ({{cite vllm/model_executor/model_loader/weight_utils.py:1529-1547}}).

load-format.short: The value of --load-format (default auto). It selects the model loader class and, for the default loader, which weight files to read.

replicated-linear.short: A linear layer that every TP rank holds in full. It splits nothing and needs no communication.

qkv-parallel-linear.short: The column-parallel layer that computes Q, K and V in one GEMM. It splits by attention heads and copies KV heads when TP is larger than the KV head count.

gather-output.short: A flag of ColumnParallelLinear. When true and TP > 1, the layer all-gathers the output slices so every rank has the full output. Default false.

reduce-results.short: A flag of RowParallelLinear (default true). When true and TP > 1, the layer all-reduces the partial sums of the ranks.

vocab-padding.short: VocabParallelEmbedding rounds the vocabulary size up to a multiple of 64 (padding_size) and splits the padded rows across TP ranks. Padding rows are zero.

pp-missing-layer.short: An identity module that stands in for a layer that another pipeline stage owns. It keeps layer indices and names the same on every stage.

intermediate-tensors.short: A dict of named tensors that a pipeline stage returns instead of hidden states. For Llama: hidden_states and residual, each [num_tokens, hidden_size].
